title: The Terminal of New Lagos
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Ansel Montrose, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
